title: Maximum Sync Queue size Exceeded!  pop-up comes up frequently on the master
symptom: The master device frequently gets a pop-up 'Maximum Sync Queue size Exceeded!' whenever an entry is made on the master, while followers receive readings without problems.
cause: The issue is related to Google services and xDrip sync, but the exact root cause is not fully established in the thread.
fix: Updating to February 11, 2021 version stopped the pop-ups for one user. For another user, disabling xDrip sync on the master and using Nightscout follower scheme is suggested to avoid the pop-up.
evidence_quote: First report on facebook that updating to February 11, 2021 has stopped the pop-ups.
